label: B25-SLD-WARNING-PROVENANCE
title: Prove the provenance and acceptance boundary of the Quartus-generated SLD warning 16788
dependency_exception: T-027 physical execution is terminal and its evidence is integrated, but its strict acceptance is blocked by the exact warning investigated here.
scope: Independently compare the T-017 and T-027 full-SoC raw synthesis reports, generated SLD topology metadata and the T-023 minimal logical-immediate probe. Prove whether the remaining warning is an unchanged Quartus 21.4 generated-fabric padding artifact or a tracked RTL/IP/QSF defect. Preserve raw warning visibility and propose only an exact, source-qualified acceptance correction if the evidence supports it.

acceptance.warning_inventory: Normalize detailed and summary occurrences into unique warning identities for T-017, T-023 old/fixed and T-027; prove that the decoder imm[63]_2 identity is absent from T-027 and that the only remaining identity is the generated SLD ir_in_2d[2][4] warning.
acceptance.topology_identity: Compare synthesized alt_sld_fab_0.sopcinfo from T-017 and T-027. Record raw and timestamp-normalized hashes/diff, COUNT, SETTINGS, endpoint hpaths, per-node IR widths, N_SEL_BITS and N_NODE_IR_BITS.
acceptance.net_semantics: Use raw Quartus reports and available generated metadata/source to explain the ir_in_2d[2][4] driver/consumer relationship and the corresponding irf/shadow_irf Lost fanout rows. Do not infer beyond available evidence; explicitly record any unavailable ephemeral generated VHDL.
acceptance.functional_chain: Check whether the unchanged SLD topology is the one used by the T-017 -> T-020 -> T-021 volatile-SOF/JTAG-UART BOOT/READY evidence chain; distinguish historical positive evidence from a new board test.
acceptance.repair_decision: Search tracked QSF/IP settings for a supported root-cause repair that preserves both EMIF JTAG and JTAG-UART nodes. Disabling either node, editing generated VHDL, message suppression, filtering or waiver is not a repair.
acceptance.contract_decision: Conclude either (a) a concrete tracked-source repair is required in a new task followed by fresh physical, or (b) the original T-027 global-zero contract mixed an unrelated deterministic vendor warning and should be superseded by a narrow source-qualified contract. Any proposed correction must retain raw reports, require zero decoder/tracked-RTL warning 16788, permit at most the exact canonical generated-SLD identity, and fail closed on any count/signature/topology drift.
acceptance.artifacts: Create evidence JSON and handoff with commands, SHA256 hashes, exact source SHA paths, conclusions and residual risks; make no RTL/QSF/SDC/IP/policy/task-ledger edits.

resource: Default work is local read-only analysis and lightweight hashing. If any GamePC read is necessary, it must hold resource-lock gamepc. Do not start Quartus compilation without a follow-up task and explicit integrator approval.
forbidden_regions: tracked RTL, firmware, QSF, SDC, IP parameters, tests, policy or task ledger
editing another task worktree or remote root
warning suppression, filtering, waiver or generated-source patching
Quartus synthesis/fitter/STA/assembler or configuration artifact generation
JTAG, board configuration, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset or power actions

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.classification: deterministic Quartus 21.4 generated SLD padding warning for the exact canonical two-node topology
result.contract: raw warning visible; tracked RTL/IP 16788 zero; one exact generated identity; normalized topology SHA fixed; all drift fails closed
result.T027: accepted under the superseding source-qualified contract
